title: Pebble launch trailer (the film's grid and the trailer's sections)

music.source: the trailer's synthesised score, written to this grid on tools/audio/synth (candidates tools/audio/scores/trailer_a.py and trailer_b.py; the judge picks one), sample-exact on the 18-frame beat
music.plan: scratchpad/research/TRAILER_RESEARCH.md section 7 and its .json report.music (the lead's binding blueprint, OVERRIDES 39-41)

how_to_use: Cut and change layouts on downbeat_frames, smaller moves on beat_frames; put the drop on reveal.frame (f648, bar 10); each sound effect peaks at its picture event + 1 frame (tools/audio/cues.json). Frame of beat k (0-based) = first_downbeat_frame + k * frames_per_beat. The trailer's movements: Tension (bars 1-9: the hook is bar 1's cold open), Reveal (10-14), Proof (15-20) and its climax (21-25), the breakdown (26-28), the title (the endcard, 29-30) and the button (final, 31-32).
harmony: the blueprint's plan (TRAILER_RESEARCH section 7): a B-minor tension (Bm(add9)); the build on G to Asus4; the drop on D major; a montage loop of D, A/C#, Bm and G in open voicing; the holds on an unresolved Asus4; the climax resolving to D (OVERRIDES 41: the tests pass on f1656, Verified's push on f1723); the final chord D(add9) on bar 31. Each candidate voices it in its own way; the per-bar chords are the chosen score's (render.json).
motif: D5 A5 G#5 A5 (five statements: bar 1 soft, bar 8 a two-note fragment, bar 10 at full level on the drop, bar 24 harmonised, bar 29 resolved)
key: D major, with a B-minor tension

superseded.note: the recut's beat map (its reveal on bar 8, its sampled score's chords and measured offsets) is kept in tools/audio/beatmaps/original-sampled.json
